payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sliding window of size k to compute maximum sum of theorems in any contiguous segment, added to the sum of theorems already obtained while awake (t_i=1).
payload.rationale: The solution zeroes out already-awake theorems to avoid double counting, then slides a window over the array to find the k-length segment with maximum sum. This is a classic O(n) amortized two-pointer approach, not dynamic programming.
